name: Dragon Disciple’s Lair
body:
You are very comfortable and alert in your chosen lair.

Prerequisite(s): 1st-level Dragon disciple, must have a lair

Benefit: Choose a specific lair, such as a series of caves, a building, or a grove, which you make your home, just like a true dragon. While in this lair, you gain a bonus to Perception checks and initiative rolls equal to 1/2 your dragon disciple level (minimum +1) and you cannot be caught flat-footed. In addition, the DC of Perception checks made to discover any objects you hide in your lair increases by the same amount.
